title: WAIT FOR ME @Hadestown PROSHOT #hadestown #hadestownmusical #musicals...
transcript: Let's go to the movies. We're gonna see Hadestown me in July. Hadestown Proshot officially has a release date in North America, and that is July 24th, 2026. It's going to be released in theatres across North America. This is a proshot that was filmed last year in London. It features the entire original principal Broadway cast. Eva Noblezada Reeve Carney, Patrick Page, Amber Gray and Andre De Shields. It also features the West End fates, Bella Brown, Madeline Charlemagne, Allie Daniel and the West End Workers Chorus. What I am most intrigued by is how they're going to do Patrick Page. Now, you probably know this, but Patrick was injured during rehearsals for Hadestown in London. Like tore his ACL Or meniscus. Something like a bad injury. Could not do the entire run of the show in London. But they did make it work for the pro shot because everyone wanted him in the pro shot. They built him like a very cool looking cast. They adjusted some of the choreography, and I'm so excited to see how they did it. And I'm so glad they did, cause I can't imagine a capture of Hadestown without Patrick Page. Hadestown is a musical that means so, so, so much to me and I'm just thrilled that it was captured in this way. I love Hadestown and I'm so glad this is gonna be an accessible way for so many people to see it. I know if you live in the UK or Europe? You're probably wondering, when is it coming to you? I don't know, but I'm sure it'll be announced soon. Anyway, I've been anticipating this news for so long. Hot girl summer? No, it's Hadestown Summer.
classificationReason: Creator is announcing the Hadestown proshot film release date (July 24, 2026) and discussing the filmed cast — news/anticipation about a film capture, not a review of the stage production itself.
